properties.displayName: UAV S63 - Firmware Update Mode Forced Entry
properties.description: UAVMavsec_CL에서 COMMAND_LONG(cmd=246 PREFLIGHT_REBOOT_SHUTDOWN, param1=3 FW업데이트모드진입)이 정비콘솔(maintenance-console) 외 소스 또는 야간 비정비시간대(OffHours)에서 발생하는 비인가 FW 업데이트모드 강제진입 탐지. MITRE: T0800
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let offHoursStart = toscalar(_GetWatchlist('UAV_Threshold_List') | where ThresholdKey == 'OffHoursStart' | project toint(Value));
let offHoursEnd = toscalar(_GetWatchlist('UAV_Threshold_List') | where ThresholdKey == 'OffHoursEnd' | project toint(Value));
UAVMavsec_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where MsgType == "COMMAND_LONG"
| where Command == 246
| where Param1 == 3
| extend HourOfDay = hourofday(TimeGenerated)
| extend isOffHours = HourOfDay >= offHoursStart or HourOfDay < offHoursEnd
| where SourceSystem != "maintenance-console" or isOffHours
| extend TriggerReason = strcat("FW업데이트모드_강제진입_PREFLIGHT_REBOOT_SHUTDOWN_", SourceSystem, iff(isOffHours, "_야간시간대", "_정비창외"))
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, SourceSystem, SourceComponent, TargetSystem, SenderIp, Command, Param1, isOffHours, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S63 - Firmware Update Mode Forced Entry - {{UAVId}}
